April 4, 2018 - By Louis Casey

Msd Capital LP sold 151,908 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.58% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Glenn Fuhrman held 92,169 shares of the apparel company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.65M, down from 244,077 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Msd Capital LP who had been investing in Pvh Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.81% or $4.24   $155.16.
